<thought>Using the retrieved DBE formula DBE = (2C + 2 + N - H - X) / 2 and the given molecular formula C11H13O3 (no N or halogens), the calculation is DBE = (2*11 + 2 - 13) / 2 = (22 + 2 - 13) / 2 = 11 / 2 = 5.5. Since DBE must be an integer, the nearest whole number is 6.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
